en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square with a large, ornate civic building labeled as the town hall. The building has a grand arched doorway with decorative stonework, a small balcony above, shuttered windows, and a coat of arms. To the left is a narrow cobbled street lined with multi‑story houses leading toward hills in the background. Several people, including children, stand or walk in the square. Printed captions at the top identify the location as Ala in Trentino and specify that the building is the Municipio (town hall).
